title: Tennis Game Score
prompt:
Implement `tennis_game_score(points)` to display the score of one completed-or-in-progress tennis game. `points` is a chronological list whose elements are `'A'` or `'B'`, indicating the player that won each rally. The input contains no rallies after the game has legally finished.

Use standard game scoring:

- Below three points each, use `Love`, `15`, `30`, and `40`. A tied score in this range is `<label>-All`.
- At three or more points each, a tie is `Deuce`. A one-point lead is `Advantage A` or `Advantage B`.
- A player wins only after at least four points and a lead of at least two; return `Game A` or `Game B`.

Return the exact display string. Process the sequence in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

example.reasoning: Player A has won one rally and player B has won two, so the displayed point labels are 15 and 30.
